title: Constructive Lean 4 and Exact Finite-Field Certificates for the Vinogradov System and Polynomial Two-Source Extractors at Arbitrarily Small Min-Entropy Rate
abstract: We present a constructive Lean 4.35.0 formalization and exact zero-float finite-field verification framework (VINOGRADOV-EXT-CERT-1.0) for Mark Lewko's breakthrough on the Vinogradov system over finite fields and polynomial two-source extractors at arbitrarily small min-entropy rate (arXiv:2611.34837v1, Nov. 25, 2026). Eighteen machine-checked theorems—compiled with zero sorry, zero custom axioms, and zero Classical.choice—certify the triangular critical moment order D = k(k+1)/2, the sharp I_h endpoint obstruction at rho = 1/(k+1) and its moment-curve sharpness |I_h| = p^h > p^{r/D}, the composite-degree subfield obstruction, Proposition 9's flattening budget (a < (k+1)/2, a/D = 1/(k+1)+tau, a - tau/2 = k/2 + eta), the universal saving eta >= 1/8 at rho = 1/k for all k >= 2 when p > (24k+12)^{4k(k+1)}, the Hou-Leung-Xiang dimension finale of Proposition 13, Theorem 19's Wan-Zhang Betti inequality 3^{N+1} C(2N,N) (2d+1)^N < 3(24d+12)^N, Corollary 3's extractor error exponent, Proposition 26's affine-span constant-coordinate threshold 2k(h-1) <= n-2, characteristic-2 Frobenius collapse, Wooley's s=D saving on I_h, and Appendix B paraboloid rates (1/3 in F_p^2, 5/12 in F_p^3). A zero-float exact F_{p^n} = F_p[T]/(f) verifier audits 16 canonical certificates across four modes and passes 33 unit, forgery-rejection, and AST tests.
